// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a2_rgb_mapping {
    intent "Raised A2 mapping with forward RGB observation and a serviceable Pi 5"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a2m12", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_camera3_front_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device2_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "cam0_power", data = @core/computer, port = "cam0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

Robot mount_strafer_a2_stereo_docking {
    intent "Planar map and stereo perception with a separate near-field docking sensor"

    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_oak_front_yoke_lite_pro", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a3_near_docking {
    intent "Raised A3 mapping with a front near-field docking reference"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a3m1", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_vl53_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Range device2_sensor(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_s3_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_camera3_front_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device2_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "cam0_power", data = @core/computer, port = "cam0")

    Mount device3_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_d435_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device3_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device3_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

installations.title: near-field docking
installations.description: A small front fork keeps the optical board upright and its bottom header accessible for a near docking target.
limits: Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
Physical fit, printing, strength, wiring, sensor response and commissioning are not established by this mechanical example.
Retain conservative Core collision findings; different neighbours require a new clearance and sensing review.
installations.snippet:
Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")
Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)

scope.core:
// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_vl53_front_fork {
    intent "near-field docking"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_vl53_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    // Carrier I2C logic follows VIN, so use the Pi 3.3 V rail with the Pi I2C bus.
    Range device1_sensor(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

installations.description: Open low frame on four measured chassis holes, with side-loaded captive M2.5 nuts and four narrow PCB pads. USB, power, HDMI, cooling and rear SD access remain open in nominal geometry.
limits: Nominal manufacturing candidate; physical fit, tolerances, cooling, loads, vibration and complete power/data/control remain unverified.
The kit control boards are omitted by its CAD. Actual board and underside nut access must be checked before closing the deck.
The camera fork uses the same front72mm pair as the sonar cradle; they cannot occupy it simultaneously.
Camera M4 insertion is nominally 3 mm versus maker drawing depth 6.5 mm; confirm the actual camera revision before fitting.

scope.core:
// Yahboom's aluminium alloy chassis as its four-wheel drive kit builds it: the two plates with the four motors under
// the lower one, on the kit's four rubber wheels, all driven.
Robot alloy4wd_pi5_oak_lite {
    intent "Yahboom aluminium alloy chassis kit, four-wheel skid-steer drive"

    Diff_drive chassis(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd")

    // The kit's motors, each on its bracket at a wheel.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.049698527324, 0.0304, -0.0686571542, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, 0.0304, -0.06867, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))

    Standard wheel_front_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_front_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount pi_carrier(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_pi5_service_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_rear_compute", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/pi_carrier, at = "pi_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
    Mount camera_fork(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_oak_lite_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_front_sonar", by = "under_holes")
    RGBD camera(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/camera_fork, at = "camera_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes")
}

installations.title: Hiwonder front Compact Arm capture dock
purposes: stock Compact Arm base capture candidate
two-arm robot with independent front and rear work areas
installations.description: A front-specific open aluminium frame locates four stock feet and uses removable toe clamps over the original baseplate, with backing strips below the actual chassis hole pattern.
limits: Core checks the declared base-plate capture and retaining chain through the dock to the chassis. Clamp preload, loads, physical fit and rotational or moving-arm clearance remain unqualified.

The host hole centers come from a coarse pinned JetAuto maker mesh associated with the green retail chassis. Purchased-kit fit, hole tolerances and material properties require physical or native-CAD confirmation.
The front dock uses M3 and the rear dock M2.5 host throughbolts with underside backing strips. These sizes are geometric candidates, not a qualified arm load rating.
Native geometry checks cover the displayed upright pose. Arm sweeps, reach under load, clamp preload, chassis bending, fatigue and stability under motion remain unverified.
The Pi carrier provides a computer location, not motor/servo control, a battery, power regulation, complete wiring or thermal qualification.
Core's conservative collision findings and unknowns are preserved. Selecting this installation does not establish a powered working robot.

scope.core:
// Yahboom's aluminium alloy chassis as its four-wheel drive kit builds it: the two plates with the four motors under
// the lower one, on the kit's four rubber wheels, all driven.
Robot yahboom_alloy_4wd_front_sensing {
    intent "Yahboom aluminium alloy chassis kit, four-wheel skid-steer drive"

    Diff_drive chassis(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd")

    // The kit's motors, each on its bracket at a wheel.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.049698527324, 0.0304, -0.0686571542, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, 0.0304, -0.06867, 0, 1, 0))
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_l_type_520_encoder_motor", glue = (-0.0497, -0.0304, -0.06867, 0, -1, 0))

    Standard wheel_front_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_front_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_left(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, 0.06015, -0.0687, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_rear_right(ref = "yahboom_alloy_chassis_4wd_wheel", glue = (-0.0497, -0.06015, -0.0687, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount sonar_support(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_sonar_cradle", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_front_sonar", by = "under_holes")
    Ultrasonic sonar(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sonar_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
    Mount cliff_support(ref = "robotdsl_yahboom_alloy_cliff_outrigger", on = @core/chassis, at = "alloy_right_cliff", by = "under_holes")
    Range cliff(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/cliff_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes")
}
